Her target-locked eye-head-body attention remains fixed on the patient. She calmly holds a capped syringe low in one hand and slides the patient's call button just beyond reach with the other; the taut cable and clear gap show that the patient's option has already narrowed. She pulls the call button toward her hip as the patient's foreground hand reaches across a clear gap; the taut cable angles toward her. The patient is the one identifiable adult counterpart. Genuine tenderness remains legible. By taking it, she appropriates access through the call button. The same adult counterpart's choice has visibly narrowed. Her slightly asymmetric tender smile stays controlled. Her gaze, head, and torso converge on the patient. Realistic skin and eye moisture, natural hands, intimate 50mm photography. The affectionate mouth, deadened eyes, controlling gesture, and visible consequence coexist in the same instant. Her affectionate mouth, lifeless gaze, syringe hand, withdrawing call-button hand, taut cable, and reaching patient hand remain simultaneously visible in one frame.
